chunks: "The beginning of the time is the decline of the sun, and it is Allah's first time, and it is the more excellent of the two."

key_terms.أَفْضَلُهُمَا: the better or more virtuous of the two
key_terms.زَوَالُ: the sun's decline from its zenith

ai.seo_question: When does the time for Zuhr salat begin, and is praying at its earliest time better?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the beginning of the salat time is at the sun's decline from its zenith. It identifies this earliest appointed time as the foremost time before Allah and the more virtuous of the two times.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.650 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"The beginning of the time (for Dhuhr prayer) is at the sun's decline (from its zenith), and it is the initial time decreed by Allah (swt), and it is the best of them."
